title: Mary Shelley's birth chart
metaDescription: Mary Shelley's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 7.5° Virgo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Virgo — the Sun, Mercury, Mars and Uranus. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 7.5° of Virgo is the Sun's exact seat — first decan, 0°–10°, sub-ruled by Mercury in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Day to day the chart speaks through Mercury in Virgo (28.0°), Venus in Libra (2.8°), Mars in Virgo (0.8°): thought with its feet on the ground, attraction that begins as conversation, effort banked steadily until it tells.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The Sun and Neptune hold the closest angle here — a sextile, 0.9° wide. A sextile pays out only on effort; the scheme calls it opportunity rather than gift. Behind it, Saturn trine Neptune at 1.1°, and Mars opposition Pluto at 1.6° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags three placements in this chart. Mercury in Virgo at 28.0° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Venus in Libra at 2.8° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Cancer at 9.5° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 4 earth, 2 fire, 2 air, 2 water by element and 5 mutable, 3 cardinal, 2 fixed by mode. Jupiter and Pluto were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Sagittarius for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.1° between midnight and midnight. The missing clock moves the Moon by half a sign at most here, and the boundary was never close. At the noon reference it stands at 22.2°.
